items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I joined Claude Hopkins (PHONETIC). And we worked hard for about three or four years.

ctx.x: Yeah. Avery Baker (PHONETIC). And he recommended me to her. So I stayed with her for about -- oh I guess about three or four years. Three or four years and then I joined Claude Hopkins (PHONETIC). And we worked hard

for about three or four years. Then I went with Benny Carter (PHONETIC). For a year or so -- a couple of years maybe. And I was with -- then I went with Count Basie (PHONETIC) a couple of times you know. Two or three times.
